nodes.name: Bug report
nodes.instruction: What the reporter tells us. Everything downstream works from these two values, so the run cannot start without them.

input_fields.label: Title
input_fields.placeholder: One line naming the broken behaviour

input_fields.label: Bug description
input_fields.placeholder: What you did, what happened, and what you expected instead. Include the error text and where you saw it.

nodes.name: Analyze
nodes.instruction: Reproduce the defect exactly as the intake report describes it — its Title names the broken behaviour and its Bug description is the reporter's account of how to see it. Then identify the root cause and name the files and functions that must change. If the report is not enough to reproduce, say so rather than guessing: do not write the fix yet, because the implement node routes on this analysis and a guess here becomes a wasted implementation attempt.

nodes.name: Implement
nodes.instruction: Apply the minimal change that fixes the root cause identified by the analysis, and add or extend a test that fails before the change and passes after it.

nodes.name: Validate
nodes.instruction: Run the project's build and test suite against the change and report exactly which checks ran and how they concluded. Report a failure as a failure: a false pass here is worse than no validation, because acceptance trusts this report.

nodes.name: Acceptance
nodes.instruction: Confirm the defect described at intake is actually gone and that the change is bounded to the root cause. Reject to whichever upstream node owns the gap.
